s02.line: For that reason, Jason goes straight into the Easy tier, because you'd outlast him by accident.

s03.line: He's big, but he had no plan of his own, so I'm putting Karl in the Don't Worry tier.

s04.line: Great plan, but she's the least dangerous fighter here, so Mrs. Loomis joins him in Don't Worry.

s05.line: He racked up bodies, but you can outfight him, so Charlie lands in the Close Call tier.

s06.line: Creepy, but one kill and done, so Quinn is a Close Call.

s07.line: Too awkward to be scary, but too close to be safe, so Ethan joins Close Call.

s08.line: That's a coin you don't want to flip, so Marco goes into the Better Run tier.

s09.line: You'd never see him coming, so I'm putting Richie in Better Run.

s10.line: Anyone willing to kill their own family belongs in Better Run.

s11.line: Unhinged and impossible to read, so Stu lands in the Almost Dead tier.

s12.line: That body count puts Mickey right into Almost Dead.

s13.line: If fire couldn't stop her, you won't either, so Amber goes into Almost Dead.

s14.line: Still, the original Ghostface goes straight into Slaughtered, just not at the very top.

s15.line: When the cop is the killer, there's nobody left to call, so Wayne is Slaughtered.

s16.line: She'd take out anyone for fame, so Jill goes into Slaughtered.

s17.line: And the deadliest Ghostface of them all takes the very top of Slaughtered.
